official_history.description: Classified cross-country results linked from the accepted FIS schedule

prediction_history.description: A separate, provenance-bearing replay may combine accepted FIS history with a validated FLGR bridge

participants.description: The official FIS startlist for the target race

russian_domestic_bridge.purpose: Maintain prediction form for returning and new Russian athletes during gaps in FIS participation.

reasons: The legacy mapper can fuzzy-match an identity or create a negative synthetic athlete ID.
The legacy merge renumbers races in the combined history instead of preserving source race identities.
The checked-in legacy feed contained future-dated result rows when audited on 2026-11-23.
The wired legacy prediction replay does not consistently update established FIS athletes from domestic results.

target_contract.fis_crosswalk: A reviewed mapping from the FLGR identity to the accepted canonical FIS-history athlete ID, name, sex, and birthdate.
target_contract.raw_evidence_storage: Operator-supplied output outside the Git repository; raw HTML is never committed.
target_contract.new_athlete_rating_rule: Replay verified domestic results against the connected rating field; established FIS athletes are calibration anchors and also update through domestic races.
target_contract.disconnected_rating_rule: A domestic component without an established FIS anchor remains low-confidence and is conservatively shrunk until connected.
target_contract.offseason_rule: Apply the accepted cross-country offseason regression to every completed season in the bridge replay.
target_contract.backtest_rule: Compare stale accepted FIS Elo, identically shaped bridge candidates, and optionally the quarantined legacy bridge against pairwise outcomes in each reviewed athlete's first later accepted FIS race. A recommendation requires the configured minimum number of distinct returning athletes and lower Brier error than stale FIS Elo.
target_contract.fixed_anchor_backtest_rule: Compare identically shaped fixed-anchor K-factor candidates with the official prior using matching rating streams and pairwise outcomes in each reviewed athlete's first A-tier race. A recommendation requires at least 20 distinct debuting athletes and lower Brier error than the official prior.
target_contract.prediction_selection: Use the latest accepted bridge rating only for a reviewed identity on the official target-race FIS startlist; otherwise use accepted FIS Elo or the newcomer fallback.

implementation_requirements: Add fixture-backed FLGR parsing and completion checks.
Reject events after the replay as-of date and retain source checksums.
Replace fuzzy automatic identity binding with exact reviewed crosswalks.
Replay stable FIS and FLGR event identities without renumbering accepted FIS races.
Backtest stale FIS Elo, the legacy bridge, and the proposed bridge against returning athletes' first FIS results.
Connect accepted bridge ratings to prediction inputs without adding domestic events to the official FIS archive.
